title: Symmetry breaking differential operators and Discrete Series
summary: For a semisimple Lie group $G$ satisfying the equal rank condition, the most basic family of unitary irreducible representations is the Discrete Series found by Harish-Chandra. In this paper, we study the structure of symmetry breaking operators for Discrete Series when restricted to a subgroup $H$ of the same type by combining classical results with recent work of T. Kobayashi, Nakahama and Pevzner.
